description: Use this when the user wants to make certificates: a certificate of completion, an award certificate, a certificate of appreciation or participation, or certificates for a whole class or team from a list of names. Returns one print-ready landscape PDF (US Letter or A4) with one certificate per person, a preview, and an optional numbered CSV register. Accepts names as a list, pasted lines, or CSV text with per-person course, award, date or hours; with no names it makes a blank fill-in certificate. Up to 500 certificates per call. Does not make diplomas or licenses that claim accreditation, does not add logos or photos, and does not email or print anything.

award.description: Award name; it becomes the certificate title. Example: Student of the Month.

certificate_type.description: Kind of certificate: completion, achievement, appreciation, participation, award, excellence, recognition or attendance. Default completion. Example: appreciation.

color.description: Accent colour as a name or hex, e.g. navy, maroon, green, gold or #1D5FC4. Default: the template's colours.

copies.description: Only for blank fill-in certificates (no recipients): how many copies, 1 to 100. Default 1.

course.description: What the certificate is for, used in the description line: a course, program, event or achievement. Example: Introduction to Python.

date.description: Date printed on the certificates in any common form (2026-06-12, June 12 2026, 06/12/2026 read as US month/day). Default today in New York. Use "blank" for a line to fill in by hand.

description.description: Your own description line instead of the generated one, e.g. for outstanding leadership of the spring food drive.

hours.description: Hours or credits completed, printed after the course. Example: 8 or "1.5 CE credits".

include_serial.description: true to number the certificates even without a prefix (prefix CERT). Default false.

organization.description: Issuing organization printed at the top, e.g. Riverside Elementary School.

paper.description: Paper size: letter (US Letter, default) or a4. Always landscape.

recipients.description: Who gets a certificate: one name, a list of names, pasted lines (one per line), or CSV text with a header row. Optional per-person columns: course, award, date, description, hours. Examples: "Ava Patel", ["Ava Patel", "Liam Chen"], or "name,course\nAva Patel,Python 101". Leave empty for a blank fill-in certificate.

serial_prefix.description: Turns on unique certificate numbers with this prefix, e.g. CERT-2026 gives CERT-2026-0001, CERT-2026-0002. A CSV register of numbers is included.

serial_start.description: First certificate number when serial numbers are on. Default 1. Example: 101.

signers.description: Up to 2 signers with name and title. Examples: "Dr. Maria Lopez, Principal; James Carter, Teacher" or [{"name":"Maria Lopez","title":"Principal"}].

template.description: Design: classic (double border, corner ornaments), modern (accent bar), academic (rosette seal), kids (bright shapes) or elegant (cream, gold, serif). Default classic.

title.description: Custom title that replaces the standard one, e.g. Star Reader Award or Certificate of Training.

name: generate_certificates
title: Generate certificates
